abstract: A man aged 33 with poorly controlled hypertension who had been treated with radiotherapy and combination chemotherapy for testicular teratoma 8 years earlier was found on arteriography to have 75% stenosis of the left renal artery and occlusion of the right renal artery. The stenosis was dilated by transluminal angioplasty and the hypertension adequately controlled. Patients who develop high blood pressure after abdominal radiotherapy with or without chemotherapy should be investigated for renal artery stenosis.
abstract_ja: 8年前に精巣奇形腫に対して放射線療法と併用化学療法を受けた33歳男性が、コントロール不良の高血圧を呈した。血管造影で左腎動脈に75%の狭窄、右腎動脈の閉塞が認められた。狭窄部は経管的血管形成術で拡張され、高血圧は十分に管理された。腹部放射線療法の有無にかかわらず、治療後に高血圧を生じた患者では腎動脈狭窄の検索を行うべきである。
